tasks.label: Diagnose Gemini call
tasks.command: Set-Location .\backend; node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const {GoogleGenerativeAI}=require('@google/generative-ai'); (async()=>{ try { const genAI=new GoogleGenerativeAI(process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY); const model=genAI.getGenerativeModel({model:'gemini-1.5-flash'}); const r=await model.generateContent('Say hello in one sentence.'); console.log(r.response.text()); } catch(e){ console.error('DIAG_ERROR:', e.message); if(e.stack) console.error(e.stack); } })();"

tasks.label: Check chat response now
tasks.command: $payload = @{ message = 'Give me one short career tip'; sessionId = 'verify2' } | ConvertTo-Json; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost:5000/chat -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $payload; if ($r.reply) { 'OK'; $r.model; $r.reply } else { $r | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 } } catch { $_.Exception.Message; if ($_.ErrorDetails) { $_.ErrorDetails.Message } }

tasks.label: Fetch live Gemini model list
tasks.command: Set-Location .\backend; $keyLine = Get-Content .env | Where-Object { $_ -like 'GEMINI_API_KEY=*' } | Select-Object -First 1; $apiKey = $keyLine.Split('=')[1]; $resp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?key=" + $apiKey) -Method Get; $resp.models | Select-Object -ExpandProperty name | Select-Object -First 30

tasks.label: Fetch live Gemini model list (fixed)
